**[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
***The [[Supreme Political Council|Houthi-led government]] accuses [[Saudi Arabia]] of an [[airstrike]] on a runway at [[Sanaa International Airport]] in [[Houthi-controlled Yemen]], which [[Yemen]]'s [[Presidential Leadership Council|internationally recognized government]] says was to stop an Iranian [[Mahan Air]] flight that was returning the Houthi delegation from the [[funeral of Ali Khamenei]].
